messages:
maria: heads up — saw a spike of noisy SLO alerts after yesterday's threshold tweak. console shows route-level override but notify-api seems to pick a different owner. anyone else seeing ownership mismatches?

dan: saw it too. console displays per-route thresholds, notify-api dedup/fingerprint logic picks the oldest owner. result = tenant override getting ignored.

alice: can we get the exact contract between console <-> notify-api? i need an example of the payload/fields so telemetry and dashboards can be wired.

maria: rough minimal example we surface in the console UI: 

```json
{
  "rule_id": "r_123",
  "owner": "team-payments",
  "scope": "route:payments.*",
  "thresholds": {"p95": 300, "error_rate": 0.05},
  "notify_policy": {"contacts": ["#payments-oncall"], "sampling": 0.1}
}
```

notify-api persists a fingerprint + canonical_owner but currently drops the UI `sampling` knob during canonicalization. that seems to be the root cause.

infra-bot: deploy-notify v2 rolled at 2024-11-01T03:12Z — changes: fingerprint-normalization. https://internal/release/notify/v2 (release note)

dan: yep — new fingerprinting collapses near-duplicate rules and loses per-rule sampling. options:
- (A) persist console-owned sampling into notify-api (easiest for runbooks)
- (B) return owner-hints to console and have UI show a best-effort owner (less coupling)

jordan: preference for A. if the API stores `ui_sampling`, runbooks + paging will be deterministic. also: we need telemetry counters for ownership_mismatch so oncall can triage quickly.

alice: telemetry proposal (short): `ownership_resolution_total` counter with labels: `rule_id`, `tenant_id`, `resolved_by` (notify|console), `sampling_rate`, `outcome` (alerted|suppressed), and a `resolution_latency_ms` histogram. also emit `ownership_mismatch` logs with a small stack of contributing rule_ids.

maria: +1. also add `legacy_fingerprint=true` label for rules that hit the old path. plan: preserve legacy fallback for 30 days during rollout.

dan: rollout plan idea:
1) feature-flag notify-api to persist `ui_sampling` as `ui_sampling` field (no behavioral change yet)
2) backfill `ui_sampling` for high-alert-volume rules only (to limit migration cost)
3) enable canonicalization to consider `ui_sampling` during resolution behind ff
4) flip ff after canary monitoring

jordan: canary details: 5% tenants, 48h windows, monitor `ownership_mismatch` rate, `false_positive_rate` and paging volume. also make sure we have an auto-rollback signal.

alice: small UX ask: console should show `resolved_by` with hover text explaining why notify-api chose a different owner (fingerprint collapse, tenant override absent, fallback). makes oncall debugging way faster.

maria: agreed. i'll draft a short RFC covering: API contract extension, telemetry schema, rollout checklist, and console hover copy. action items: 
- dan: API change PR (persist `ui_sampling` in notify-api)
- alice: telemetry + dashboards for ops & SRE (ownership-resolution dashboard + alert rule)
- jordan: canary gating config and rollback signals
- maria: RFC + console hover text + coordinate QA

pinging @dan @alice @jordan for ack :eyes:

dan: ack :+1:
alice: ack :white_check_mark:
jordan: ack :rocket:
